name: TOR Monitoring Workflow
description: Automated Time Out of Refrigerator (TOR) monitoring for pharmaceutical materials. Polls SAP S/4HANA EWM for warehouse task confirmations, evaluates TOR thresholds against CAP service records, issues warning alerts (80%) via SAP Agent advisory and breach alerts (100%) with automatic stock blocking, and logs a full audit trail on fridge put-away.

parameters.input: ={{ 'Batch ' + $json.batchId + ' for material ' + $json.materialId + ' has reached ' + ($json.elapsedPercent * 100).toFixed(0) + '% of its TOR limit. Elapsed: ' + $json.elapsedMinutes + ' min, TOR limit: ' + $json.torLimitMinutes + ' min, remaining: ' + $json.remainingMinutes + ' min. Provide an EXPEDITE or HOLD recommendation with urgency level and brief reasoning.' }}
